normalization: Each component divided by equal-fire MAE of a training-median predictor on the corresponding training cohort, floored at 1 flux unit.
split_rule: Outer test fire excluded. Three whole inner fires with at least three first-month dates. Hash choice using identifiers and row counts among groups containing 15-35% of outer training rows; nearest 20% fallback. No flux values used for split choice.
cohort_thresholds: Internal high rows and peak daily means use p95 from inner training only. Reporting uses frozen previous training-only thresholds for matched comparisons.
training: Physical SmoothL1 beta10; first-month weight3; weighted arm multiplies training raw-target-above-p95 weights by5; each batch normalizes by weight sum.
selection: Per seed, checkpoint and land-cover mode use its arm validation objective. Final arm is minimum validation-ensemble peak score among arms whose validation full MAE is at most 1.05 times inner_arcsinh_capped. That control is always a fallback. Choices persisted before test files are read by comparison.
caveat: Exploratory repeated evaluation. Past satellite inputs from the outer fire are available at prediction time; its labels are never used for fitting, thresholds, scaling, stopping, or objective selection. Comparisons to the previous study change training rows and validation protocol together; new arms have paired identical inner splits.
